			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_venetian_arsenal_inaugurated value >= 6 } }

	OR = {
		AND = {
			has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
			is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 149 }
			OR = {
				AND = {
					location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_belgrade_fortress_inaugurated value >= 1 }
					NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_belgrade_fortress_inaugurated value >= 2 } }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|149)" ?= { this >= 2 }
				}
				AND = {
					location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_belgrade_fortress_inaugurated value >= 2 }
					NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_belgrade_fortress_inaugurated value >= 3 } }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|149)" ?= { this >= 3 }
				}
				AND = {
					location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_belgrade_fortress_inaugurated value >= 3 }
					NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_belgrade_fortress_inaugurated value >= 4 } }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|149)" ?= { this >= 4 }
				}
				AND = {
					location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_belgrade_fortress_inaugurated value >= 4 }
					NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_belgrade_fortress_inaugurated value >= 5 } }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|149)" ?= { this >= 5 }
				}
				AND = {
					location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_belgrade_fortress_inaugurated value >= 5 }
					NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_belgrade_fortress_inaugurated value >= 6 } }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|149)" ?= { this >= 6 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_belgrade_fortress_inaugurated value >= 1 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_belgrade_fortress_inaugurated value >= 6 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_surveyed }
				NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_surveyed target = 149 } }
			}
		}
	}

			OR = {
				AND = {
					location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_malbork_castle_inaugurated value >= 1 }
					NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_malbork_castle_inaugurated value >= 2 } }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|182)" ?= { this >= 2 }
				}
				AND = {
					location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_malbork_castle_inaugurated value >= 2 }
					NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_malbork_castle_inaugurated value >= 3 } }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|182)" ?= { this >= 3 }
				}
				AND = {
					location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_malbork_castle_inaugurated value >= 3 }
					NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_malbork_castle_inaugurated value >= 4 } }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|182)" ?= { this >= 4 }
				}
				AND = {

					NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_malbork_castle_inaugurated value >= 5 } }

					NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_malbork_castle_inaugurated value >= 6 } }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|182)" ?= { this >= 6 }

		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_malbork_castle_inaugurated value >= 1 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_malbork_castle_inaugurated value >= 6 } }

	OR = {
		AND = {
			has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
			is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 206 }
			OR = {
				AND = {
					location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_sanaa_old_city_inaugurated value >= 1 }
					NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_sanaa_old_city_inaugurated value >= 2 } }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|206)" ?= { this >= 2 }
				}
				AND = {
					location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_sanaa_old_city_inaugurated value >= 2 }
					NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_sanaa_old_city_inaugurated value >= 3 } }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|206)" ?= { this >= 3 }
				}
				AND = {
					location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_sanaa_old_city_inaugurated value >= 3 }
					NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_sanaa_old_city_inaugurated value >= 4 } }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|206)" ?= { this >= 4 }
				}
				AND = {
					location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_sanaa_old_city_inaugurated value >= 4 }
					NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_sanaa_old_city_inaugurated value >= 5 } }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|206)" ?= { this >= 5 }
				}
				AND = {
					location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_sanaa_old_city_inaugurated value >= 5 }
					NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_sanaa_old_city_inaugurated value >= 6 } }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|206)" ?= { this >= 6 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_sanaa_old_city_inaugurated value >= 1 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_sanaa_old_city_inaugurated value >= 6 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_surveyed }
				NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_surveyed target = 206 } }
			}
		}
	}

tv_wonder_location_meets_unique_augsburg_bank_base_site_rules_trigger = {
	this = location:augsburg
	OR = {
	  is_capital = yes
	  location_rank ?= location_rank:city
	  location_rank ?= location_rank:megalopolis
	}
}

tv_wonder_location_has_unique_augsburg_bank_intermediate_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_augsburg_bank
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_augsburg_bank_foundation
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_augsburg_bank_body
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_augsburg_bank_function
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_augsburg_bank_decoration
	}
}

tv_wonder_location_has_unique_augsburg_bank_final_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_augsburg_bank_inaugurated
	}
}

tv_wonder_location_has_unique_augsburg_bank_expandable_final_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
			is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 211 }
			OR = {
				AND = {
					location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_augsburg_bank_inaugurated value >= 1 }
					NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_augsburg_bank_inaugurated value >= 2 } }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|211)" ?= { this >= 2 }
				}
				AND = {
					location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_augsburg_bank_inaugurated value >= 2 }
					NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_augsburg_bank_inaugurated value >= 3 } }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|211)" ?= { this >= 3 }
				}
				AND = {
					location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_augsburg_bank_inaugurated value >= 3 }
					NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_augsburg_bank_inaugurated value >= 4 } }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|211)" ?= { this >= 4 }
				}
				AND = {
					location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_augsburg_bank_inaugurated value >= 4 }
					NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_augsburg_bank_inaugurated value >= 5 } }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|211)" ?= { this >= 5 }
				}
				AND = {
					location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_augsburg_bank_inaugurated value >= 5 }
					NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_augsburg_bank_inaugurated value >= 6 } }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|211)" ?= { this >= 6 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

	AND = {
		tv_wonder_location_meets_sacred_mountain_base_site_rules_trigger = yes
		NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_sacred_mountain_intermediate_building_trigger = yes }
		OR = {
			AND = {
				NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_sacred_mountain_final_building_trigger = yes }
				NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_sacred_mountain_capped_final_building_trigger = yes }
			}
			tv_wonder_location_has_sacred_mountain_expandable_final_building_trigger = yes
		}
	}
}

			NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_sacred_mountain_intermediate_building_trigger = yes }
			NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_sacred_mountain_final_building_trigger = yes }
			NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_sacred_mountain_capped_final_building_trigger = yes }
		}
	}

tv_wonder_location_can_host_unique_walls_of_benin_trigger = {
	AND = {
		tv_wonder_location_meets_unique_walls_of_benin_base_site_rules_trigger = yes
		NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_unique_walls_of_benin_intermediate_building_trigger = yes }
		OR = {
			AND = {
				NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_unique_walls_of_benin_final_building_trigger = yes }
				NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_unique_walls_of_benin_capped_final_building_trigger = yes }
			}
			tv_wonder_location_has_unique_walls_of_benin_expandable_final_building_trigger = yes
		}
	}
}

			NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_unique_walls_of_benin_capped_final_building_trigger = yes }

	}

tv_wonder_selected_ritual_completion_requirements_met_trigger = {
	tv_wonder_has_selected_ceremony_trigger = yes
	trigger_if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = tv_wonder_selected_ritual_has_custom_completion_trigger
			var:tv_wonder_selected_ritual_has_custom_completion_trigger ?= 1
		}
		tv_wonder_selected_ritual_custom_completion_requirements_met_trigger = yes
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_selected_generic_timed_ritual_trigger = yes }
		NOT = { has_variable = tv_wonder_ritual_timer }
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_selected_generic_auxiliary_building_ritual_trigger = yes }
		has_variable = tv_wonder_ritual_auxiliary_building_finished
	}
	trigger_else = { always = yes }
}

		}
		tv_wonder_selected_generic_timed_ritual_trigger = yes

}
